name: Truist Enjoy Cash Credit Card

apr.notes: 0% intro APR on purchases for 12 months after account opening and for 12 months on balances transferred within 90 days of account opening, then 18.99% to 27.99% variable APR. Cash advance APR 27.99% (Prime plus 20.99%). Balance transfer fee 3% ($10 minimum).

base_rate.description: 1% cash back on all other eligible purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: A 10% to 50% Loyalty Cash Bonus applies, based on the Truist deposit relationship, when cash rewards are redeemed into an eligible Truist deposit account.

notes: Applicants choose one of two earning options at application and cannot change it later: 3% on gas and EV charging and 2% on utilities and groceries (combined $1,000 monthly spend cap) with 1% on everything else, or a flat 1.5% on all eligible purchases. This record models the tiered option. The product page links both Visa Signature and Visa Traditional benefit guides, so the package depends on the account and network_tier is none.
